data_objects.name: province_partition_labels
data_objects.meaning: Record-level binary outcomes with data-partition labels and Chinese province-level location names.

variables.name: flag
variables.meaning: Data partition code with observed values train, vali, and test.

variables.name: label
variables.meaning: Binary 0/1 outcome indicator; the positive-class business definition is not supplied.

structure.description: Each row is one identified record. flag defines the provided train/validation/test partition, and prov_name supplies a geographic grouping field.

uncertainties: The positive label and the sampling rules behind the three partitions are not documented.
annotation_notes: The validation partition is spelled vali in the source.
